newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares end mixed, BUX index firms.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares end mixed, BUX index firms.

text.p: Hungarian shares closed mixed in slower-than-average trade on Wednesday, but rising share prices in Europe helped the BUX index to firm slightly, Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) traders said.
"Stocks rose because the U.S. did not raise interest rates on Tuesday and foreign markets opened higher in the morning," Raiffeisen Securities' Attila Berecz said.
The BUX index closed at 3,439.69 points, up 15.97.
Spot share turnover amounted to one billion forints, down from 1.21 billion forints on Tuesday.
The BSE shares traded in relatively low turnover, with the buyers being cautious and the sellers hardly moving, Berecz said.
He added that Hungarian stocks are not likely to change much in the next few weeks as market players are already waiting for the third-quarter figures of the companies.
